raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting with batch 12, the source stopped sending status 'POSTED' and now sends 'SETTLED'. The status counts fit a one-to-one relabel: all 995 SETTLED rows sit in batches 12-14 (1056 rows), and the remaining ~61 rows are REVERSED, about the same ~5.5% reversal rate as earlier batches. No change note documents the relabel, so the source team should still be asked to confirm it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status IN ('POSTED', 'SETTLED')"}}
